title: Safari Booking at Kaziranga National Park

gallery.alt: Safari Booking at Kaziranga National Park

content.text: If you want to experience an excursion full of adventure in the wildlife sanctuary and get close to nature, then you can book a safari in the Kaziranga National Park with us. Both Jeep Safari and Elephant Safari are available for an adventurous ride at the Kaziranga National Park. Enjoy and explore wildlife closely and get an experience of a lifetime. You can book a safari for four zones in Kaziranga which are Central (Kohara) Zone, the Western (Bagori) Zone, the Eastern (Agaratoli) Zone and the Ghorakati (Burapahar) Zone.

items.text: To avoid last-minute unavailability of Elephant Safari bookings, we suggest booking your safari in advance.
Morning slots (5:00 AM – 6:00 AM and 6:00 AM – 7:00 AM) are allotted one day before your scheduled Elephant Safari.
Elephant Safari is done only in Central and Western Range.
Children below 5 years are considered minors, while those above 5 years are treated as adults.
Children above 5 years are considered adults, while those below 5 years are complimentary, subject to availability of jeep seat.
A maximum of 5 persons are permitted in one safari jeep.
The timing of Jeep Safari in Kaziranga National Park is from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM in the morning and from 1:30 PM to 3:00 PM in the afternoon.

blocks.text: Safari Zones in Kaziranga National Park

content.text: The possibility of witnessing a tiger, one-horned rhino, swamp deer, wild buffalos, etc. is relatively high in the Central (Kohora) Zone of Kaziranga National Park. And a lot of tourists choose to visit this area.

This region of Kaziranga, known as the Western (Bagori) Zone, is mesmerizing due to its richness of wildlife species and lush greenery. Due to the existence of water bodies like ponds where they may satisfy their thirst, it also draws the majority of the animals in Kaziranga National Park. As a result, it is easy to see top creatures like tigers, rhinos, and elephants here.

The national highway passes through the Eastern (Agartoli) Zone, which is also open to jeep safaris and even elephant safaris. This area of Kaziranga National Park is one of the most popular areas for wildlife photography.
The entry gate for the Burapahar (Ghorakti) Zone is located in the village of Ghorakati, which is 40 kilometres away. You may go for trekking in this area.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Elephant and Jeep Safari Booking at Kaziranga National Park

items.question: 1. Where is Kaziranga National park located?

answer.text: Kaziranga National Park is located in the state of Assam within Golaghat and Nagaon districts. The Kaziranga National Park is a world heritage spot as it holds two-thirds of the total population of one-horned rhinoceros.

items.question: 2. Which safari is best in Kaziranga?

answer.text: In terms of comfrt, jeep safari is a good option but travelling with an elephant is much less and after safer because the elephants are gentle giants of the jungles and other animals feel scared to come closer to these gentle giants.

items.question: 3. What is special about Kaziranga National Park?

answer.text: Kaziranga National park is home to the world’s largest two-thirds of the total population of rhinos. It also serves other animals like tigers, large cats and leopards etc which makes it special.

items.question: 4. How many zones are available in Kaziranga for jeep safari?

answer.text: In Kaziranga the Central zone (kohora), Eastern Zone (Agaratoli), and Western Zone (bagori) are available for jeep safari.

items.question: 5. What time is suitable for visiting Kaziranga?

answer.text: Visiting kaziranga in between November to April is advisable, because at this period of time the weather of Assam is very pleasant neither too hot nor too cold.From June to August Assam receives heavy rainfall and by the month of November Kaziranga gets ready for tourism.

items.question: 6. For what time period Kaziranga remains closed ?

answer.text: Kaziranga remains closed from June to September because at this period of time the weather is not favourable in Assam.

items.question: 7. Inside Kaziranga National park hotels are there?

answer.text: Yes ,lodges and camps are there inside the National Park for its visitors. And you can find these lodges in the Central Zone (kohara) or in Western Zone (Bagori).

yes, for wildlife lovers kaziranga is a best place for visiting as it has various types of plants and animals for exploring. It also allows them to witness the rhinos, Asian elephants, wild buffalos etc in their natural state.

items.question: 9. In how many days can we explore the kaziranga?

answer.text: Two days are required for exploring the national park.on day one you can do a jeep safari and explore kaziranga and on the second day you can go for a safari with the gentle giants

items.question: 10. Is kaziranga safe for its visitors?

answer.text: Yes,it is totally safe as long as you stay inside your jeep or on the back of an elephant getting down from the vehicles or elephants can get you into great trouble. Also to ensure the maximum safety listen to your guide or expert instructions carefully.
